source_envelope.translation_marker: KJV: King James Version (1769) with Strongs Numbers and Morphology and CatchWords

record_shape.book: object with name and chapters keys in source order
record_shape.chapter: object with chapter and verses keys in source order
record_shape.verse: object with verse and text keys in source order
record_shape.text: string retained exactly, including any source whitespace

mapping.book: one TEI div[@type=book] per source books item in source order; name is a head
mapping.chapter: one nested TEI div[@type=chapter] per source chapters item in source order; chapter number is n and head
mapping.verse: one nested TEI ab[@type=verse] per source verses item in source order; verse number is n and text is the exact source text
mapping.derived_identifiers: xml:id values and book/chapter/verse ordinals identify source positions; they are not source editorial content

normalization.source_marker: retained exactly as the source translation field
normalization.unsupported_fields: The source marker mentions Strong's, morphology, and catchwords, but the retained verse objects expose only verse and text fields; no unsupported fields are invented.

source_boundary: The one retained KJV.json document is the complete assigned source member. Its 66 books, 1189 chapters, and 31102 verse objects are included in source order. The 66 data/bible-text/kjv JSON files are downstream segmentation and are not TEI authority. No source members, top-level fields, book objects, chapter objects, verse objects, or verse text values are excluded.
